commit_message:
[Bazel] Fix flatcc and bitcode library include paths when IREE is an external repo (#25101)

The fixed paths ("-I runtime/src", "-I .", fixed llvm-project header
paths) just work if IREE is the main bazel module. For IREE as a
dependency embedded in another bazel module, the paths need to be
prefixed with "external/" + repo-name with repo-name being the canonical
repo-name used by the main bazel module.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code

---------

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
name: samples
